text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: The CPI shows the average price level of goods and services purchased by consumers. This is expressed relative
to a base year – in this case 2010. For example, a CPI of 120 means that prices were 20% higher than in 2010.

tspan.tspan: International Monetary Fund (IMF) International Financial Statistics, via World Bank (2026)
